method: Every configured 2024 district is listed. District two-party D-R margin is 100*(D-R)/(D+R), and lean is district margin minus the national margin, using the Wikipedia lead infobox vote totals. Missing candidate totals remain null; no results are imputed.
nationalSourceNote: Totals as displayed in the 2024 House elections Wikipedia lead infobox; preserved as a prior-cycle fallback source.
